import sys, json, time, random, cProfile, pstats, io
sys.path.insert(0, 'tmp'); sys.path.insert(0, 'submission')
import ref, main as M
N = 64
cyc = [1000 + 11*i for i in range(N)]
rnd = random.Random(2)
rib = []
for L in range(3, 21):
    for s in range(N):
        if len(rib) >= 998: break
        p = [cyc[(s+j) % N] for j in range(L)]
        rib.append({'path': p, 'count': rnd.randint(1, 1000)})
        rib.append({'path': p[::-1], 'count': rnd.randint(1, 1000)})
rib = rib[:998]
agg = {}
for r in rib:
    t = tuple(r['path']); agg[t] = agg.get(t, 0) + r['count']
final, rounds = M.peel(list(agg.items()))
core=set()
for p in final:
    for i in range(len(p)-1): core.add(M._canon(p[i],p[i+1]))
order = ref.find_order(ref.scope_graph(ref.ref_occurrences(final), core))
doc = {'version':1,'ixps':[],'rib':rib,'priors':[],'declared':[],
       'order':[[u,v] for u,v in order],
       'queries':[{'id':'q%d'%i,'path':[cyc[(i+j)%N] for j in range(64)],'threshold':[1,2]} for i in range(512)]}
spec = M.validate(doc)
pr = cProfile.Profile(); pr.enable(); M.solve(spec); pr.disable()
s = io.StringIO(); pstats.Stats(pr, stream=s).sort_stats('tottime').print_stats(10)
print(s.getvalue()[:2400])
EOF
